sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामं सुपर्णः सुमहाबलः ।परिष्वज्य सुहृत् स्निग्धमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ।। ६.५०.५५ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tato rāmaṁ suparṇaḥ sumahābalaḥ ।pariṣvajya suhṛt snigdhamāpraṣṭumupacakrame ।। 6.50.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Having said so, Suparna endowed with mighty strength embraced Rama most affectionately and took leave of him.
